tm.長い年月によって 装丁が かすれている。\nかなり古い本のようだ……。: The binding has faded with the long years. It seems to be a very old book...
tm.なんと 本の間に\nボロボロの手紙が はさまっている！: Amazingly, a tattered letter is tucked between the pages!
tm.どうやら 聖地ラムダで見せてもらった\n手紙の続きのようだ。\n{var:1}は: It seems to be the continuation of the letter shown to you in sacred Arboria. {var:1} read the letter.
tm.……でも なぜでしょう。世界は 変わらず\n美しいままなのに あなたがいない……: ...But why? The world is as beautiful as ever, yet you're not here... and that alone makes everything seem faded.
tm.ああ ムネが 張り裂けそう……。\nローシュ……あなたと会えない日々が\nこんな: Ah, my heart is about to burst... Erdwin... that days without you could be this painful...
tm.いつかまた 会える日が来ると信じて\n私は 今日も ひとり竪琴を奏でます。\nこ: Believing the day will come when we meet again, I play my lyre alone today as well. May this melody reach you...
tm.吟遊詩人が教えてくれた 手紙の続きを読んだ！\n聖地ラムダのよろず屋の前にいる\: You read the rest of the letter the minstrel mentioned! Go tell the minstrel in front of the general store in sacred Arboria!
